versions.summary: Baseline at the start of the schema registry (FB-151). Before it, 0.1.0 was edited in place while it was a draft. At the baseline every schema took the one id form forge://fxts/<framework>/v<version> and gained integrity.schema_version and integrity.schema_hash.

FB-177: objects beside points: a module declares the collections it shows, each with its schema; a command may target an object; a surface lists the objects it shows; a contract may have no points (D-16, Q-3 and Q-15)
